caption: The drawing depicts a metal object consisting of a flat rectangular base with four arched, looped metal bars extending vertically from the base at regular intervals, creating semi-circular arches across the length of the base. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting the use of pencil or charcoal on a light cream or beige paper. The object has two short, straight legs attached perpendicularly to the underside of the base at each end, providing support and elevation. Additionally, a flat, elongated handle extends from one end of the base, angling upward and outward. Each of the arches, as well as the handle and legs, exhibit a consistent dark tone indicative of metal material. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, focusing all attention on the detailed depiction of the object.
title: Toast Rack
